note: D07 Wikidata research, 2026-10-18, WDQS SPARQL GETs one at a time with User-Agent YukemuriCatalogUpdater/1.0 (+https://github.com/jihune/yukemuri). The Action API answered 429 from this environment and was not used again.

queries.purpose: External-id properties whose English label names hotels, Jalan, ryokan, Rakuten, onsen, accommodation or lodging
queries.query: SELECT ?p ?l WHERE { ?p a wikibase:Property ; wikibase:propertyType wikibase:ExternalId ; rdfs:label ?l FILTER(LANG(?l)="en") FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?l),"hotel") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?l),"jalan") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?l),"ryokan") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?l),"rakuten") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?l),"onsen") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?l),"accommodation") || CONTAINS(LCASE(?l),"lodging")) }
result: Leading Hotels of the World hotel ID

queries.purpose: Every item with a Trip.com hotel ID and its ko/en/ja labels and country (19 MB, kept out of the repository)
queries.query: SELECT ?item ?trip ?ko ?en ?ja ?country WHERE { ?item wdt:P10425 ?trip . OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P17 ?country } OPTIONAL { ?item rdfs:label ?ko FILTER(LANG(?ko)="ko") } OPTIONAL { ?item rdfs:label ?en FILTER(LANG(?en)="en") } OPTIONAL { ?item rdfs:label ?ja FILTER(LANG(?ja)="ja") } }

queries.purpose: Lodging items in Japan by class, with Korean labels and Trip.com ids (a class counted twice for an item in two)
queries.query: SELECT ?cls (COUNT(DISTINCT ?item) AS ?n) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?ko) AS ?nko) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?tr) AS ?ntrip) WHERE { VALUES ?cls { wd:Q27686 wd:Q562930 wd:Q11562938 wd:Q48835818 } ?item wdt:P31 ?cls . ?item wdt:P17 wd:Q17 . OPTIONAL { ?item rdfs:label ?ko FILTER(LANG(?ko)="ko") } OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P10425 ?tr } } GROUP BY ?cls
